name: Public Records — PDF to text & Markdown (OCR, DOCX, RAG chunks) to HTTP
author: Public Records
description: Run publicrecords/pdf-docx-to-markdown on YOUR Apify account via HTTP, then use the JSON rows in later modules (Google Sheets, Slack, email, a vector store). Set APIFY_TOKEN in a Make connection or variable. Do not hard-code a token. Official Make gallery submission needs a Make account and is not included.

metadata.notes: Rebuild in Make with the HTTP module if import of this blueprint is rejected; the URL, method, header and body are the recipe.
